Scene-OTC-Bench
Evaluating Scene Critique for Design Intelligence
Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
OmniAI Group of ZJU ACES Lab


  
  
  
  


Scene-OTC-Bench evaluates whether vision-language models can distinguish better scene designs from poorer ones. Given two or four renderings of the same room, a model must rank the scenes from best to worst, considering physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence.
